masthead.purpose: The paper's name in red slab type; also the running-head name and crew-card issuer.

display.purpose: Front-page banner headline, fitted to one full-measure line above 1080px.

headline.purpose: Inside page heads; the same face sets WANTED, the slogan, the back-page close, drop caps and big numerals.

title.purpose: Rail heads, column subheads, ad heads.

deck.purpose: Italic standfirst under each page head, captions, submast.

body.purpose: Reading copy and newspaper columns; 17px at 760px and below.

label.purpose: Datelines, nav, table headers, fact terms; uppercase.

wire.purpose: Wire copy and data only: blotter, contract address, folios, bylines, rail readouts.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The one soft offset shadow: live button, wanted poster, crew card.

shadows.name: page-edge
shadows.purpose: Upward shadow of the inside-page stack as it turns over the front page; paired with an 18px crease gradient rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.14) to transparent.

materials.name: newsprint-grain
materials.value: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, var(--ink) 0.55px, transparent 0.9px) / 5px 5px, opacity 0.07, position fixed
materials.purpose: Halftone grain over the whole sheet; fixed so scroll never repaints it.

materials.name: halftone-photo
materials.value: canvas 45-degree dot screen from Robin's SVG; coarse cell 18px to fine 3.2px; line-art plate mix 0.16
materials.purpose: The only photo material; positive (light dots) in night final.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: CSS transitions: button hover/press, coupon border, running head drop (0.45s).

motion.name: head-slam
motion.value: rule --rule-draw 0 to 1 over 0.9s; headline from scale 1.16, blur 7px, opacity 0 over 0.85s; deck clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) over 0.8s; expo.out; ScrollTrigger start top 78%
motion.purpose: Shared press run on every inside page head.

motion.name: front-press-run
motion.value: EXTRA yPercent -110 (0.7s); banner lines scale 1.18 + blur 8px, stagger 0.12; lede, deal and rail clip-path rolled; expo.out

motion.name: page-turn
motion.value: pin front at bottom bottom for +=100%, pinSpacing false; .front__sheet scale 0.94, brightness 0.82, scrub
motion.purpose: Signature move: inside pages slide over the held front page.

motion.name: section-moves
motion.value: take shares scaleX from 0 stagger 0.18; notice rules clip wipe stagger 0.07; wanted slapped on back.out(1.6); crew card y 46 rotate 2.5 to -1 then stamp scale 2.2 power4.in; vault rows x -14 stagger 0.045; blotter entries ScrollTrigger.batch scale 1.06 power4.out; back close slammed like a head
motion.purpose: One content-native move per section after the shared head slam.

motion.name: fuse-burn
motion.value: --burn tween 1.4s power3.out; flame keyframes 0.42s steps(2) alternate
motion.purpose: Escrow progress toward the next heist.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Skips every GSAP timeline, the pin and Lenis; halftone drawn at fine screen; fuse set directly; CSS durations 0.01ms.

narrative.overview:
The site is one sheet of cheap 1930s crime tabloid that keeps going to press. The engine's state is the news: the front page headline is set from live data, the heist schedule is a column of copy, the leaderboard is the stock quotations, the sell log is the police blotter, and the back page is the classifieds. Everything is ink on gray newsprint with one red, cut in wood type and laid out on a column grid with drawn rules. No surface pretends to be an app.

Density is a newspaper's: tight leading on headlines, generous body measure, rules doing the work that cards and boxes do elsewhere. Material is printed: a fixed halftone grain over the whole sheet, photographs printed as halftone screens computed from the mascot's own art, double rules under the masthead and above every page. Motion is a press run: rules are drawn, headlines slam onto the sheet out of a blur, decks are printed down by a roller, and the front page is turned over by the pages beneath it. The late edition (dark scheme) is the same paper printed in light ink on black stock.
keyCharacteristics: Cold gray newsprint ground with stepped paper tones; ink, never pure black.
One red, used for the masthead, the EXTRA bar, snitch counts, the one live action and the fuse flame.
Five self-hosted faces with strict jobs: slab masthead, condensed wood-type headlines, serif reading copy, narrow sans labels, typewriter wire copy.
Square newspaper geometry; the crew card is the only rounded object.
Halftone as the photo material; one soft shadow for paper lying on paper.
Press-run motion with a pinned front page that the next pages slide over.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the only hue on the sheet. It marks the paper's identity (masthead, EXTRA), the danger (snitches) and the one action worth taking (the live buy). A second accent breaks the newspaper.

rules.name: The Ink Not Black Rule
rules.body: Ink is warm carbon (`ink`), never `#000`; paper is gray stock, never `#fff`.

rules.name: The Job Per Face Rule
rules.body: Each face has one job. League Gothic never sets body copy; PT Serif never sets labels; Courier Prime is for wire copy and data only, never headings or prose.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every live number uses tabular figures so counts and prices do not jitter as they update.

rules.name: The Rules Do The Boxing Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from printed rules (hairline, 2px, 4px, and 5 to 6px double), not from cards, fills or gaps.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: There is one soft shadow. Hard offset shadows, glows and stacked elevations do not belong to newsprint.

dos: Do keep red to its jobs: masthead, EXTRA, snitch counts and slogan, the one live action, the fuse flame, the out stamp, focus and selection.
Do separate content with printed rules (hairline, 2px, 4px, double) before reaching for boxes or fills.
Do give each face its one job: League Gothic for heads and big numerals, PT Serif for reading, Archivo Narrow for labels, tables and buttons, Courier Prime for wire copy and data.
Do print images as halftone from the real mascot art, at a fine screen at rest.
Do invert to ink on paper for pressed states on buttons and the coupon.
Do open every new inside page with the drawn double rule, folio, slammed headline and rolled deck, then one move native to its content.
Do define every color as a token and redefine it for night final; nothing hard-codes a light-only value.
Do collapse all motion to the finished static sheet under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, gradients or tinted panels.
Don't round corners on anything but the crew card at 10px.
Don't use any shadow other than the lift and the page-turn edge; no hard offset shadows, glows or blur panels.
Don't set prose or headings in Courier Prime, or body copy in League Gothic.
Don't use stock photos or full-color art on the sheet; Robin's palette only reaches the page through halftone or grayscale.
Don't use pure `#000` ink or pure `#fff` paper.
